aboutMe.label: Who I am
aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.bio: With a background in hospitality, I bring human-centric care to code. I bridge the gap between people and technology, turning client visions into seamless digital experiences through empathy, clarity, and technical precision.
aboutMe.location: Based in Schleswig-Holstein, Germany. Working worldwide
aboutMe.curiosity: Finding better ways to solve problems is what makes building things exciting. Technology never stops evolving, and neither do I.
aboutMe.approach: Every challenge is a feedback loop. My approach blends analytical thinking to dissect root causes with creativity to design clean, non-standard solutions when typical patterns fall short. When hurdles appear, persistence keeps the momentum going, and collaboration ensures every idea gets refined into its most efficient form.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.pleaseContact: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding on my previous knowledge.
technologies.bio: I leverage modern front-end technologies to build clean, responsive, and user-centric web applications. colleagues.heading: What my colleagues say about me

reviews.name: Frank Preuß
reviews.quote:
Ron has a talent for thinking through complex problems without losing sight of what matters. When dealing with tricky logic challenges, he finds solutions you wouldn't have thought of yourself - often turning a complicated problem into a simple fix.
I also appreciate his open nature in sharing his knowledge and helping others out. He gets up to speed on new topics quickly and puts his ideas straight into practice.
Collaborating on our Kanban project was a lot of fun, and I would gladly work with him again anytime.

reviews.name: Sven Primus |
reviews.quote:
Ron is a doer.
While others figure out where to start, Ron exceeds expectations by getting things done. No matter how complicated the challenge, he finds a way.
He eagerly learns new technologies and shares findings with the team when something sparks an idea or helps others. During our bootcamp, we built a Kanban board application together over five weeks. It was a great experience, and every team could use someone like Ron.

reviews.name: Michael Schmidt
reviews.quote: Ron brings a rare blend of strong technical execution and genuine collaborative spirit. Whether he's diving into a difficult bug or exploring a new framework, his enthusiasm is contagious. Collaborating with him on our Kanban application showed me firsthand how much value he adds from day one.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Text: General information: The following gives a simple overview of what happens to your personal information when you visit our website. Personal information is any data with which you could be personally identified.
privacy.sec2Text: We host our portfolio on external servers or cloud services. The personal data collected on this website is stored on the servers of the hosting provider. This may include IP addresses, contact requests, metadata, and communications.
privacy.sec3Text1: If you send us inquiries via the contact form, your details from the inquiry form including the contact data you provided there will be stored by us for the purpose of processing the inquiry and in case of follow-up questions.
privacy.sec3Text2: We use EmailJS to handle contact form submissions. Your data is transmitted securely to deliver your message to our email inbox. We do not share this data with third parties.
privacy.sec4Text: You have the right at any time to request free information about your stored personal data, its origin, recipients, and the purpose of its collection. You also have the right to request the correction or deletion of this data.
privacy.sec5Text: If you have any questions regarding data protection, please feel free to reach out via our contact page.
